verdict.rationale: Justworks documents creating PTO policies from the Time Off tab of the Justworks Payroll account, with setup fields for policy type, policy cycle, balance structure and timecard sync. This shows native policy definition with some link to payroll and time data. Accrual rules are only implied by 'balance structure', and approvals are not documented at all. Missing for 10: explicit accrual configuration documentation, approval workflow evidence, explicit confirmation that approved PTO flows automatically into payroll runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll

citations.quote: Start by selecting into the Time Off tab in the left-hand side menu of your Justworks Payroll account. Then, click the Policies tab, followed by the + Add policy button.
On the setup page you'll be able to enter these key policy details: Policy name ... Policy start date ... Policy end date ... Policy type ... Timecard sync
